## What happened?

Describe the result you expected and what you saw.

## How can we reproduce it?

Include the interface or command, the comparison targets, and the smallest example you can share. Synthetic repository names and code are welcome.

## Environment

Include the Own the Diff version or commit, OS, Python version, Git version, and browser if relevant. Please remove private paths, credentials, and proprietary diffs.
